spec.assertion: A sakura-cast buff of magnitude 8.15 reaches >=3 distinct allies including herself, caps at maxStacks 10, is NOT an offensive StatKey, and zeroing it leaves the whole board byte-identical. Fails under: self-only / top-ATK targeting, no stack cap, or an ATK/damage-stat encoding of "of DEF".
Patching the carrying block's trigger to shotFired must yield >=2x as many 8.15 applications. Fails under hitCount:1 / shotFired / interval encodings (base would already equal the patched count).

No sakura-cast buffApply carries magnitude 7.74. Fails under the nearest-wrong encoding as a generic attackDamagePct/elementDamagePct 7.74 to all allies. Mechanic itself it.skip'd — the sim has no enemy projectiles.

Full-burst count over 180s: base > seconds:0 (live), base > oncePerBattle:true (every FB, not once), base > target:self (all allies), and cdr-zero also lowers team damage. Fails under a missing/inert CDR, a once-per-battle encoding, or a self-scoped target.
Directional: re-keying the block to burstCast can only lose activations (fb <= base), because liter contests the Burst I slot. Weakly separable in this fixture — flagged, not overstated.

No buffApply anywhere carries magnitude 90.72 (either sign). Fails under the nearest-wrong reading of an INCOMING-damage reduction as an outgoing damageTakenPct boss debuff, which would inflate the entire team.

spec.kitLine: ATK up 23.76% of skill user's ATK
spec.assertion: casterAtkPct buffApplies from sakura resolve to ONE identical flat value (>100, not ~23.76) across >=3 allies incl. self; doubling 23.76 raises team damage; extending 10s->30s raises team damage. Fails under stat atkPct (raw 23.76, per-target variation), a missing buff, or a wrong/burst-window duration.

No 23.54-magnitude buff from sakura under any stat other than partsDamagePct; where partsDamagePct IS modelled, zeroing it leaves the board byte-identical (partless v1 boss). Fails under an attackDamagePct/elementDamagePct 23.54 encoding.

spec.kitLine: when Cherry Blossom Tea at max stacks
spec.assertion: it.skip — no stack-count block gate primitive exists (resourceGate reads a declared resource pool, not a buff's stack counter). Additionally unreachable: ~1.37s per charged SR shot x3 = ~4.1s/stack vs a 15s stack life => ~3-4 stacks steady state, never 10.

fixtures: controlComp('sakura', true) only — liter (Burst I) / crown (Burst II) / sakura / helm (Burst III), deterministic, no seed. The fixed Burst III slot is mandatory: sakura is Burst I and a comp without a Burst III makes ZERO full bursts, which would render every rotation and burst assertion vacuous. 10 hoisted runs: base + 2 skill1 counterfactuals (value->0, trigger->shotFired) + 4 skill2 CDR counterfactuals (seconds->0, oncePerBattle, target->self, trigger->burstCast) + 2 burst-ATK counterfactuals (value x2, durationSec 10->30) + 1 parts counterfactual (value->0). All counterfactuals locate their target by kit MAGNITUDE rather than slot/trigger shape, and every one records its match count so a no-op patch fails loudly instead of producing a vacuous green.
gaps: skill2 'When attacking an enemy projectile, damage to that projectile up 7.74% continuously' — it.skip: the sim models no enemy projectiles, so the payload is unobservable. Only its non-leakage into a generic stat is assertable.

burst 'Activates when Cherry Blossom Tea is at max stacks' — it.skip: no primitive gates a block on another buff's stack count (resourceGate reads a declared resource pool, not buff stacks). Independently moot — 10 stacks are arithmetically unreachable at her charge cadence (~4.1s per stack vs a 15s stack life).

(flag) skill1 stat ambiguity: the prose gives 'Cherry Blossom Tea: 8.15% of DEF' with NO stat keyword before an up/down marker. Read as a DEF grant (defPct). A DEF->ATK conversion reading has no primitive at all (there is no atkOfDefPct StatKey, unlike atkOfMaxHpPct), so the assertions bind to magnitude/stacks/target-set plus a 'not an offensive stat' check, which holds under either defensive encoding.

(flag) FIXTURE RISK — controlComp seats liter (Burst I, short CD) alongside sakura (Burst I, 40s CD). If the engine's first-ready-in-window selection always prefers liter, sakura's own burst never casts and the entire burst block goes unexercised. Handled by an explicit 'FIXTURE PRECONDITION' test plus it.skipIf on the dependent assertions: if that precondition is the only RED in the file, it is a fixture limitation, not a driver divergence. A comp with exactly one Burst I unit would be the correct fixture, but no sanctioned harness helper builds one.

(flag) DOC CONTRADICTION in the packet: the harness-boilerplate section says the OverrideFile's slots are CharacterSkills objects carrying their own blocks[], while the override-file-shape section says the slots ARE Block[] arrays. blocksOf() handles both shapes rather than guessing; if the judge knows the true shape, the helper can be simplified.
